hellenistic-reference.html#checklist.label: 10 Art-use checklist and anachronisms to avoid

decision:unbased-doric.label: Doric columns have no bases and stand on the paving

decision:pan-and-cover-roofs.label: Roofs are flat terracotta pan tiles under narrow cover tiles, with eave-end tiles

decision:courtyard-houses.label: Houses are plastered rubble, blind to the street, open onto a court or portico

decision:crown-citadel.label: The crown is a small solid ruined dry-stone ring wall; the posts are hollows among crags

decision:chamber-conical-roof.label: The Chamber is a Greek round hall: a Doric peristyle round the drum, one conical roof of pan and cover tiles on timber rafters held up by six columns inside, a small lantern at the apex

decision:retired-dome.label: RETIRED: the stone dome, coffers and oculus of the old Chamber

decision:ring-road-plan.label: One cliff road with a lane each way joins terraced harbour towns; agora and stoa frame the quay

decision:messenger-kit.label: Messengers are bare-headed in an exomis, strapped sandals and a hide pera

decision:loom-woven-dress.label: Everything worn is a loom-woven rectangle, draped and pinned, never tailored

decision:cast-by-colour.label: Same-kind figures differ only by clothing colour

decision:scrolls-not-bound-books.label: In-world records are papyrus scrolls and wax tablets; no codex or bound ledger

decision:retired-bound-books.label: RETIRED wording: loot book, law book, ledger, leather-bound

decision:sandglass-timers.label: Four men start together by turning a sandglass (a deliberate anachronism for narrative convenience; the Greek timer was the water clock)

decision:merchant-ships.label: Merchant ships are round-hulled Kyrenia-type sailing ships with steering oars; no galleys, sloops or barges

decision:ring-road-carts.label: Carts and pack animals carry goods; two-wheeled carts and handcarts, no stirrups, no wagons on the cliff shelf

decision:camp-kit.label: A mercenary's camp is one linen tent, a plain shield, a chest and a wicker basket

decision:coins-and-seals.label: Attic silver coin with owl and goddess, signet seal rings, stelai for decrees

decision:no-people-on-plates.label: Island plates and terrain plates show habitation only through objects: no people, no animals
